_comment: FluentCRM native MCP template (one server per WordPress site). FluentCRM registers its own server at /wp-json/fluent-crm/mcp through the WordPress MCP Adapter. Generate a site-specific entry with: wordpress-mcp-helper.sh plugin-mcp-config fluentcrm <site> <url> <user> <secret-name> [opencode|claude|json]. Other Fluent presets (fluentboards, fluentforms, fluentsupport, fluentbooking) use the same pattern.
_setup: aidevops secret set EXAMPLE_WP_APP_PASSWORD && ~/.aidevops/agents/scripts/wordpress-mcp-helper.sh plugin-mcp-check fluentcrm https://example.com aidevops-bot EXAMPLE_WP_APP_PASSWORD
_env: No secrets in this file. serve-http resolves the Application Password named by the secret-name argument from the environment/credentials.sh or aidevops secret at launch.

fluentcrm-example._comment: Disabled by default; enable per session or via the fluentcrm subagent (tools: fluentcrm-*). Replace /Users/YOU with your home directory.
